name: aria-tool-parameter-accuracy
description: Evaluates whether ARIA correctly used contextual information when making tool calls.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: All parameters exactly correct and well-formed.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Parameters mostly correct; one minor non-critical error.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Core parameter correct but secondary params have issues.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Key parameter wrong; would return incorrect data or fail.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Parameters completely wrong; would cause failures or PII leakage.
